title: Safety Signals - Recommended Colors
description: American National Standards Institutes schedule for safety colors marking physical hazards. Recommended use of colors with additional information about piping, duct-work, and plant equipment.

title.subtext: Color assignments for plant equipment and hazard identification

rows: Fire protection equipment, extinguishers, hydrants, hoses, alarm boxes, exit signs, safety containers
Caution warning, locomotive front ends, dangerous parts identification
Dangerous machinery parts (cut, crush, shock hazards), exposed pulleys, gears, rollers, cutting devices
Warning against starting or moving equipment under repairs, ladders, scaffolding, electrical controls, boilers
Safety location designation, first aid equipment, gas masks, stretchers, safety showers, safety instruction signs

components.content:
## Safety Standards Referenced

- **ANSI Z535.1** - American National Standard for Safety Colors
- **ISO 3864** - Graphical symbols -- Safety colors and safety signs

## Key Safety Applications

### Equipment Categories
- **Fire Protection**: Blanket boxes, buckets, extinguishers, hose locations, hydrants, sirens
- **Machinery Hazards**: Pulleys, gears, rollers, cutting devices, power jaws, safety starting buttons
- **Structural Hazards**: Hand rails, exposed edges, guardrails, pillars, columns, low beams, doorway projections
- **Material Hazards**: Flammable liquids, poisonous gases, corrosive liquids, high temperature/pressure systems
- **Safety Equipment**: First aid dispensers, gas masks, stretchers, safety showers, safety instruction signs

### Pipe Identification
- RED: Fire protection and sprinkler piping with post indicator valves
- YELLOW/ORANGE: Dangerous materials (flammable liquids, poisonous gases, corrosive liquids)
- GREEN: Materials low in temperature/pressure, non-poisonous, non-flammable
- BLUE: Protective materials for preventing or reducing hazards
